[[Naman Fal]]'s '''son''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who attended the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Considered to be weak in the dark side, Naman Fal's son was very friendly and talkative during his time in the academy. His father believed he would never be talented as a Sith, however, the son wanted to prove himself to his father that he was a Sith. During his trial, he traveled to the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]] where he met sentry [[Yashia]] who was guarding the tomb. After the acolyte was killed and never returned, Yashia grew worried and decided to send a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] to find the body and return it to Naman Fal.<ref name="TOR" />
